chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Husayn ibn Thuwair, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
"When famine strikes you, pay attention to raisins."

key_terms.اعْتَنُوا: Pay attention to / take care of / prioritize

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of raisins during famine according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights raisins as a critical sustenance during famine, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on practical wisdom in preserving life (*hifz al-nafs*). This advice underscores the nutritional density and storability of dried grapes, which were historically vital for survival in arid climates, aligning with the Prophetic tradition of valoring dates and raisins as blessed foods.
